newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stock prices will be mixed on Wednesday with selling pressure on shares of telecom utility PTCL likely to offset new accounts day buying, dealers said.
"PTCL will ease as the stock is over-bought which is likely to drag down the index slightly," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said. "PTCL has a heavy weightage in index and it leads sentiment."
On Tuesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-index fell 11.85 points, or 0.74 percent, to 1,581.52 amid 171 losers and 92 gainers.
